name: explainer-api
description: Hono API, Better Auth, and PostgreSQL for the Explainer visual-journalism platform.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Signing secret for sessions. Generated at setup; rotating it signs everyone out.

INTERNAL_API_KEY.description: Shared secret the Astro frontend uses to preview unpublished stories.

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL of this API, e.g. https://explainer-api-xxxx.herokuapp.com

FRONTEND_URL.description: Public URL of the Astro site; used for CORS, reset links, and seeded media URLs.

TRUSTED_ORIGINS.description: Optional comma-separated extra origins (custom domains, preview deployments).

S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3-compatible endpoint (Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2). Leave blank for AWS S3.

S3_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public/CDN base URL for the bucket. Leave blank to proxy reads through /media/* instead.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional Resend API key. Without it, outbound email is logged instead of sent.
